name: Canada Wild Onion

facts.what: Bulbs, greens, and spring bulblet heads
facts.how: Anywhere an onion or chive belongs

caution: THE RULE HAS NO EXCEPTIONS: no onion smell, no eating. Crow poison mimics it leaf for leaf and bulb for bulb but has no odor, and it grows in the same lawns.

sections.title: Identification
sections.body: Grassy leaves from a small bulb, and the unmistakable test: crush a leaf and the whole plant must announce itself as onion. Silence means crow poison; leave it.

sections.title: In the kitchen
sections.body: The greens are wild chives, the bulbs are shallots in miniature, and the little aerial bulblets pickle into perfect cocktail onions.
